screen.subject: お見積もり（修正版）
screen.line: 使用料に保守費用を含む

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to Kamaru Business Japanese.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today is lesson 8: 25 words — phone calls & negotiations.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First, let's listen to a phone call with a client.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Thank you for calling. This is Kobayashi at Minato Medical.
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: Thank you as always. This is Yamada from Sakura Systems. Thank you for the other day.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: Likewise. What can I do for you today?
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: There's a change to part of the quote we gave you the other day, and I wanted to let you know right away.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: I see. Which part?
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: We've changed the fee for the new system so that it includes maintenance.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: I see. Can I download the materials already?
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: Yes, they're already on the site. Please enter the password to view them.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: Thank you. Internally we place weight on the effects and benefits of adopting it, so could you report on that too?
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: Of course. I'll explain the setup and the effects at our next meeting, with materials summarising them.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: Also, the person in charge in the relevant department would like to tour the factory.
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: Certainly. We'll arrange a meal together after the tour as well.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: That helps. When we understand each other well, the negotiations go more smoothly.
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare with your team's level in mind.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: Now let's go through today's words one by one. First: deals & meetings.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A business discussion.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I have a business meeting with a client this afternoon.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: Eating together with business contacts.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I booked a restaurant for a dinner with clients.
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: Discussing and settling things in advance.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Let's have a meeting tomorrow at ten.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: Putting terms in front of someone.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We presented the new price to the other party.
lines.name: 小林

segments.meaning: the matter at hand (what one is calling about)

lines.en: The business you have come or called about.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: May I ask what this is about?
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: The other day.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Thank you for the other day.
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: Thoughts or feelings getting through to someone.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Mutual understanding matters in a team.
lines.name: 山田

segments.meaning: tour, visit to observe (e.g. a factory)

lines.en: Learning by seeing for yourself.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The new employees toured the factory.
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: Letting someone know the results of work.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll report what was said in the meeting to the department manager.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: Next: systems & data.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A setup made of several parts working together.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We'll use a new booking system from next month.
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: Getting data from the internet.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: You can download the materials here.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: Typing text or data into a computer.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please enter your name in roman letters.
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: Using something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This meeting room can't be used this afternoon.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: How a whole is put together from its parts.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll rethink how the presentation is structured.
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: Fitting a condition.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Circle the items that apply.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: Having something inside; including.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Tax is included in the price.
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: A small part of the whole.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I revised part of the materials.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: Last: what matters.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Very urgently.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Could you call me urgently?
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: Already.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I've already sent that document.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: Treating something as especially important.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Our company puts quality first.
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: Paying attention to something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I speak with the customer's feelings in mind.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: A good result coming from something you did.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The ad had an effect right away.
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: A good point; an advantage.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The advantage of this method is that it is fast.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: A degree or standard.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The training splits classes by Japanese level.
lines.name: 小林

lines.en: Treating illness and injury.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This company makes medical equipment.
lines.name: 山田

lines.en: Finally, let's check with a quiz. Choose the answer from 1 to 4.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 1. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 用件, what it is about.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 2. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 1: 含まれて, included.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: What is eating together with business contacts called?

lines.en: Question 3. What is eating together with business contacts called?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 3: 会食.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 4. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 4: 至急, urgently.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: Which word means a good point or advantage?

lines.en: Question 5. Which word means a good point or advantage?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 1: メリット.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.name: ナレーター
